name: Đầu ghi NVR Lite Hikvision DS-7104NI-Q1/M
summary: Video Input and Transmission – Connectable to the third-party network cameras – 4 network cameras can be connected Compression and Recording – H.265+/H.265 compression effectively reduces the storage space and costs – Full channel recording at up to 4 MP resolution HD Video Output – HDMI/VGA output at 1080p resolution Storage and Playback – 1-ch playback at 4 MP resolution or 2-ch at 1080p resolution – 1 SATA hard disks can be connected with 6TB capacity Smart Function – Supports line crossing and intrusion detection – Smart search for the selected area in the video
and smart playback to improve the playback efficiency Network & Ethernet Access – Hik-Connect for easy network management – 100 Mbps Ethernet network interface
